transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been having these evenings after work where, especially if I’ve been really strict with myself all day, I end up eating much more than I planned. It’ll start with dinner, then I keep going—cereal, crackers, leftovers, sweets—all within a couple of hours.
After one of these episodes of eating a lot, do you ever do anything to try to make up for it—like make yourself vomit, use laxatives, fast, or exercise a lot?
Yeah. The next day I’ll usually skip breakfast and lunch to try to make up for it. Or I’ll take an extra-long hike, or push myself harder at softball conditioning, even if I’m already tired.
How often do these binge eating episodes followed by compensatory behaviors happen, and how many months has this pattern been going on?
For the past few months, it’s been most weeks—usually one or two nights a week. Then the next day I’ll skip meals or exercise longer to try to make up for it.
During these episodes when you're eating a lot, do you feel like you can't stop or control what or how much you're eating?
Yes. Once I start, I keep going back to the kitchen even when I’m telling myself to stop. I don’t really feel in control again until I’m uncomfortably full.
How much does your weight or body shape affect how you feel about yourself overall?

It affects me more than I’d like to admit. If my waistband feels tight before a client luncheon or a leadership meeting, I start thinking I look sloppy and that people won’t take me seriously—even though I know I’m still doing my job.
Can you tell me your current height and weight, and whether your weight has been significantly low for your body compared to what's expected?
I’m not sure of my exact weight right now, and I don’t really know what would count as significantly low for my body.
Have you or your doctor noticed that your weight is unusually low for your height, or has anyone expressed concern that you look underweight?
No, no one’s said I look underweight, and I haven’t really noticed that myself. I honestly don’t know whether my weight would be low for my height.
